answer: Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
